title: Pre-flight: .env names set twice; Fly's hint corrected
why: Jason, 2026-11-17, setting up the Fly edge: the new FLY_API_TOKEN didn't take because .env still had the old line above it, and the site uses the first line for a name and ignores the rest. 1. A new line under The site itself, needed for launch: ".env names each set once". It counts the names (never the values) and names any set twice, with their line numbers. 2. Fly's line no longer says a deploy token can't read certificates (it can: Jason's deploy token for trvgo-edge passes); it says to use the whole "FlyV1 …" line from fly tokens create deploy, set once, and links the traversence organization's tokens.
